title: Private Secret La Jolla Art, Viewpoints and Architecture Tour
includes: Your expert guide Julie will take as many photos of you as you want
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
If you have a child in your party under 8 years old, you must bring your own child car seat or booster seat, depending on their age. It is NOT okay for the child to sit on your lap
You will be shuttled in a midsize car. If there are 4 adults in your party this might be uncomfortable since 3 sit in the back.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This private tour with award winning tour guide Julie Kremen showcases some of the outstanding yet hidden scenery of the La Jolla area, plus funky, quirky and mind-boggling art and architecture. You’ll also experience “San Diego’s newest tourist attraction” – a remarkable treasure that even locals don’t know about! 

But Shhhhh…. don’t tell anyone about these places….they’re secret!

Note: This 4 hour tour is a private tour, but it is fully customizable; contact Julie to book as described above or to discuss how to change to suit your needs.
